pr_title: Bug 4925 daylight out of order bar
pr_body:
<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
Reverted PRs https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/pull/3708, https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/pull/4700

behind these changes a few main ideas:
1) In most cases in Lean we calculate `EndTime=Time + resolution`. it means that `EndTime` is built in the same TZ as `Time`, because simple arithmetic operation doesn't take into account TZ itself. It works for standard situation. But broken when it comes to specific days when we switch TZ to Daylight/Standard.

That's why both `potentialbarEndTime` and `next.EndTime` should be in the same TZ (Daylight/Standard). because of  `next.EndTime` is built in 'current TZ' we also need to build  `potentialbarEndTime` in 'current'. To do that  it's necessary to `RoundDown` origin day and then add interval, while those PRs rounded down the day + interval, which would not work for daily resolution because we missed the 2am of Sunday where the movement actually happens. In the https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/pull/4700 we tried to compensate that by adding `daylightMovement` but didn't worked for minute resolution on pre-market data

2) Usually `Time` and `EndTime`  are in the same TZ, but if we consider that specific day of Daylight movement, we can find that `Time` is one TZ, but `EndTime` in another. In `master` we ignore that, so ff'ed bar `Time` and `EndTime` are always from the same TZ, but it breaks 'next' step. To fix it we need apply their own TZ to `Time` and `EndTime`

There are a few examples (DataTimeZone = UTC-5; Exchange TimeZone = America/new York)

**Standard Time** 
00:00:00 => 1.00:00:00
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/101540420-091fb680-39b1-11eb-9025-85185a1a388e.png)

**Daylight Time**
01:00:00 => 1.01:00:00
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/101540551-39ffeb80-39b1-11eb-9949-b85750fd988f.png)

### **EDGE CASES**

**Standard => Daylight**
00:00:00 => 1.01:00:00
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/101540828-a24ecd00-39b1-11eb-85a7-910fa85c5120.png)

**Daylight => Standard**
020:00:00 => 1.19:00:00
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/101541033-dde99700-39b1-11eb-8590-534bef05b7d1.png)

Worth to mention that `NodaTime` consider 1 AM - 2 AM as interval _after_ daylight move, so it's sensitive for DataTZ and ExchangeTZ, for example

DataTZ = UTC; ExchangeTZ = America/New York
020:00:00 => 1.19:00:00

DataTZ = UTC-5; ExchangeTZ = America/New York
01:00:00 => 1.01:00:00

<!--- Please link to the issue here: -->
Closes #4925 

#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
On minute resolution error was thrown for pre-market data `FillForwardEnumerator received data out of order`.

<!--- Include details of your testing environment, and the tests you ran to -->
<!--- see how your change affects other areas of the code, etc. -->

- unit tests. Created a lot of different test cases for different Exchange and DataTimeZone values. Run it against master first; save results and then after fix. Fixed expected data due to changes. Some failed results listed below (left - master; right - branch)

![2020-12-08_22-07-01](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/101538906-c8bf3900-39ae-11eb-9f62-3073e67444be.png)
![2020-12-08_22-08-20](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/101538914-cb219300-39ae-11eb-8371-d97e93f2e6bf.png)
![2020-12-08_22-09-35](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/101538921-cd83ed00-39ae-11eb-855f-ad6697ba877f.png)
![2020-12-08_22-45-58](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/101538930-cfe64700-39ae-11eb-9abb-89cbed949eae.png)
![2020-12-08_23-15-40](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/101538931-d1b00a80-39ae-11eb-9581-e3c08f0393bf.png)
![2020-12-08_23-17-45](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3648114/101538937-d379ce00-39ae-11eb-8bc6-95a67091dcdf.png)


- regression test for minute resolution checking first bar after daylight movement

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
- `FillForwardEnumerator received data out of order` due to fill forward `TradeBar` being emitted with time 9:30 after the next data point 8:33, believe due to the `daylightMovement`. 
#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->
Review daylight savings adjustment logic. Add tests reproducing the issue.

```
public override void Initialize()
{
    SetStartDate(2008, 3, 7);
    SetEndDate(2008, 3, 10);
    AddEquity("SHY", Resolution.Minute);
    // just to make debugging easier, less subscriptions
    SetBenchmark(time => 1);
}
```
